scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Hey, I know you.
You took this test
before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
嘿，我认识你。
你以前参加过这个测试，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Ah, you must have been
to Valhalla and been reborn.
Wow, that's so impressive!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
啊，看来你去过瓦尔哈拉并转生了。
哇，真厉害！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Err...
You'd better learn all the Basic Skills first before you can become an Archer.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
那个...
在成为弓箭手之前，你最好先学会所有的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Alright, see you later.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
好的，回头见。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Well then. I don't
need to say anything else.
I know you'll make a great Archer...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
那么。我没什么要补充的了。
我相信你会成为一名出色的弓箭手...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Although there's no special
reward for you this time, I hope you understand. Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
虽然这次没有特别的奖励，希望你能理解。保重。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Oh...?
Hey, what are
you doing here...?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
哦...？
嘿，你在这里做什么...？

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I can tell that you're not cut out to be an Archer. It sort of feels like you're meant to do
something else...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
看得出来，你并不适合当弓箭手。感觉你似乎更适合做点别的...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Good day. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你好。有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I want to be an Archer.
scripts.translation: 我想成为弓箭手。

scripts.text: I need the requirements, please.
scripts.translation: 请告诉我要求。

scripts.text: Nothing, thanks.
scripts.translation: 没什么，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
You've already become an Archer...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你已经成为弓箭手了...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Hmm...
You don't look much like a Novice at all...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
嗯...
你看起来完全不像个初心者...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Anyway, whatever you are, you can't choose a job as an Archer because you have a job already.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
总之，不管你是谁，既然你已经有职业了，就不能再选择弓箭手作为职业。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Do you want to be an Archer?
If so, you need to fill out this application form.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你想成为弓箭手吗？
如果是的话，你需要填写这份申请表。

scripts.text: Apply.
scripts.translation: 申请。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Okay, sign here. Alright, um, I'll promote you once you meet the requirements.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
好的，在这里签字。嗯，当你满足要求后，我会为你办理晋升。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
If you think you've met them already, we can check that now.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
如果你觉得已经满足了要求，我们现在就可以检查。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 是的，我是。

scripts.text: No, not yet.
scripts.translation: 不，还没准备好。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Alright, let me check.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
好的，让我检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I understand. Be my guest if you want to look at the requirements.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
我明白了。如果您想查看晋升要求，请随意。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Well, alright.
See you next time.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
好吧。
下次再见。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Are you...{0}?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你是...{0}吗？

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Well, you're not at the right job level. Please check the requirements again.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
嗯，你的职业等级不够。请再次确认晋升要求。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Your job level must be at least 10, and don't forget you should learn all of the Basic Skills. Once you've done that, come back.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你的职业等级必须至少达到10级，并且别忘了要修满所有基本技能。完成后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Excellent!
Now then,
let's see...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
很好！
那么，
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I will appraise the value of the various types of Trunks, needed to produce a Bow, that you've brought.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
我将评估你带来的、用于制作弓的各种木材的价值。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Um...
Unfortunately you didn't bring any of the required items. There's nothing for me to appraise.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
嗯...
很遗憾，你没有带来任何所需的物品。我没有什么可以评估的。

[Archer Guildsman]
Less than 25!? You have to get a grade of at least 25! Come on, try harder!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
不到25分？！你至少需要达到25分才行！加油，再努力一点！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Wow! More than 40!
Excellent! Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
哇！超过40分了！
太棒了！恭喜你！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
More than 30! Nice job!
Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
超过30分了！干得不错！
恭喜你！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
*Sigh* Well, you just barely passed... Anyway, well done.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
*叹气* 嗯，你只是勉强及格而已... 不过，做得好。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I'll transfer these Trunks to our Bow Production Department. Now that you've met the requirements, let me promote you right away!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
我会把这些箭筒转交给我们的弓生产部门。既然你已经满足了要求，让我立刻为你晋升吧！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Congratulations!
You are now an Archer!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
恭喜你！
你现在是一名弓箭手了！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Of course, we expect that you will help contribute towards the future of the Archer Guild with your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
当然，我们也期待你能通过自己的努力，为弓箭手公会的未来做出贡献。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Ah, your bow has arrived from the Bow Production Department. Here, take it! It's yours~
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
啊，你的弓已经从弓生产部门送来了。给你，拿去吧！这是你的了~

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Now, off you go. Hunt with pride, knowing you were trained by one of the best!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
好了，去吧。带着骄傲去狩猎吧，要知道你是由最优秀的人训练出来的！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I will explain the requirements for being an Archer.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
我来解释一下成为弓箭手的要求。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
But...
You're already an Archer. You should know these already...
So...Yeah...no real reason to tell you the requirements...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
但是...
你已经是弓箭手了。你应该早就知道这些了...
所以...嗯...没什么理由再告诉你要求了...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Wait a second. You've chosen a different job already. You don't need to know this~
So...Yeah...no real reason to tell you the requirements...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
等一下。你已经选择了其他职业。你不需要知道这些~
所以...嗯...没什么理由再告诉你要求了...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
First of all, you have to the Job Level 9 as a Novice, and know all of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
首先，作为初心者，你的职业等级必须达到9级，并且掌握所有基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
An Archer needs extremely high concentration and reflexes, so we do not accept those who have little patience.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
弓箭手需要极高的专注力和反应速度，所以我们不接受缺乏耐心的人。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
You also have to gather ^FF0000Trunks^000000. There are 4 different types of Trunks, each of differing quality. You'll be given different grades for your Trunks, depending on their quality.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你还必须收集^FF0000箭筒^000000。共有4种不同类型的箭筒，质量各不相同。根据箭筒的质量，你会获得不同的等级评分。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
In order to become an Archer, you must receive a grade of at least ^0000FF25^000000 points out of 40. You can get Trunks from 'Willow,' the tree. Be careful, though. They can be tough monsters.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
为了成为弓箭手，你必须在40分中至少获得^0000FF25^000000分。你可以从“树精”身上获得箭筒。不过要小心，它们可是很难对付的魔物。
